source: Apache Commons Compress GitHub Pull Request and source history
technology: Apache Commons Compress / Java / framed LZ4 and Snappy decoders
error_description: Reading an input stream containing very large numbers of legal empty LZ4 frames or Snappy padding chunks can terminate with StackOverflowError rather than reaching end-of-file normally.
i_base: FramedLZ4CompressorInputStream reads end markers and initializes subsequent concatenated frames.
FramedSnappyCompressorInputStream processes stream identifiers and padding or skippable chunks while searching for the next data block.
The LZ4 and Snappy frame formats permit zero-output units that may appear repeatedly before EOF.
The regression tests exercise 200,000 concatenated empty LZ4 frames and 200,000 Snappy padding chunks.
Callers expect malformed or exhausted input to be reported through the declared IOException path; StackOverflowError is outside that checked-error contract.

ccdg.details: End-marker processing reaches the next frame parser.
Stream identifier or padding chunks produce no data and require continued parsing.

ccdg.source: legal empty frame or padding chunk
ccdg.details: A long run of such units makes recursion depth depend on input length.
The fix advances through empty units with loops.

ground_truth.entity: repeated legal zero-output frames or padding chunks
ground_truth.operation: advance to the next data block or EOF

software_twin_snapshot.observed_failure_signal: Reading many legal empty LZ4 frames triggered stack overflow on the pinned pre-fix revision; the companion Snappy padding regression also failed.
